title: orbitopt lunar free-return (Artemis II) mission config v1.0
description: A user-editable YAML/JSON config for the Artemis-II-like lunar free return (orbitopt.viz.mission_timeline.build_from_config): TLI from an Earth parking orbit, a lunar flyby at a targeted perilune altitude, and an unpowered return to the Earth entry interface inside the lunar-return skip-entry corridor. Same strictness convention as the other mission configs (additionalProperties: false everywhere). Every section besides `mission` and `output` is optional; omitted fields fall back to the values the 'artemis2' built-in mission uses. Not a reproduction of the flown mission -- NASA hasn't published navigation-grade state vectors.

schemaVersion.description: Which version of this mission-config schema the document was written against.

id.description: Stable slug for the produced scene, e.g. 'artemis2'.

departure.description: TLI epoch: give either `date` or `mjd2000`, not both. Default 2026-08-01 00:00 (the built-in mission).

parking_orbit.description: Circular Earth parking orbit TLI departs from. Default 185 km.

transfer.description: Seed geometry for the free-return targeter.

coast_days_guess.description: TLI-to-lunar-arrival time used for the Lambert seed and the Moon's arrival position. Default 3.5 d.

theta_deg.description: Parking-orbit transfer angle behind the Moon's arrival direction, i.e. where TLI happens. Default 142 deg.

perilune_altitude_km.description: Targeted closest-approach altitude above the lunar surface. Default 6545 km (Artemis II).

target_fpa_deg.description: Inertial flight-path angle targeted at the 121.92 km entry interface. Must lie inside the lunar-return skip-entry corridor [-7, -5] deg, which the exported trajectory is re-checked against. Default -6 deg.

total_days.description: Upper bound on the exported span (it is cut at the entry interface anyway). Default 12 d.

step_size_s.description: Export propagation step. Default 60 s; much coarser steps give unphysical flybys.

max_output_points.description: Decimate the exported trail to at most this many samples. Default 700.

verification.description: The free-return targeter is itself TudatPy-verified and the exported trajectory's entry corridor is always re-checked; `enabled: false` (or `orbitopt run --skip-verify`) only omits the machine-readable verification report.

scene_file.description: Where `orbitopt run` writes the produced scene-1.0.json document; overridable with --out.

verification_report.description: Where `orbitopt run` writes the machine-readable verification report (verification-report-1.0.json schema). Default: next to the scene as <scene stem>.verification.json.
